title: CAPILLARY BRIDGE
description: Discrete droplets fall, attract and bridge around persistent wet spots written by the pointer. Surface tension, wetting, evaporation and feed rate move the piece between isolated beads, transient chains and broad capillary clustering.

visual_finish.composition: falling bead clusters form off-centre capillary chains around user-written wet zones with generous warm negative space
visual_finish.material_model: translucent green-black liquid beads with restrained highlights, contact shadows and thin capillary bridges
detail_scales: individual beads, highlights and wet halos
